task.description:
Follow the design docs from Step 01 (validated by Step 01b).

ISS-601 (src/engine/instance.zig, migrations/GBL-085_state_snapshots.sql):
- Create instance_snapshots table: instance_id UUID, snapshot_seq BIGINT, state JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
- Reconstruction: check for latest snapshot; if exists, load it and fold events with seq > snapshot_seq
- Snapshot creation: every ~1000 events per instance, persist current state as snapshot
- Join event_payloads_overflow when reconstructing full event payloads
- Verify NFR-04: benchmark replay of 10k events < 5 seconds

ISS-602 (scratch/expr_diff_harness.zig or tests/tools/):
- Differential harness: load gateway conditions from corpus (JSON file or DB query)
- Parse each condition with BOTH vendor/cel AND src/expr/
- Evaluate on sample data; assert identical boolean output
- Catalog any divergence: condition text, CEL result, expr result, diff
- Gate: no production import of src/expr/ on engine path until corpus is 100% green
- Create a small initial corpus from existing process definitions

After both: zig build (exit 0), zig build test (exit 0). Commit and push.
acceptance_criteria: instance_snapshots table created via migration GBL-085
Reconstruction folds events since latest snapshot (not full replay)
Differential harness compares CEL vs expr results on real gateway conditions
No production import of src/expr/ on engine path (gate enforced)
Initial corpus created from existing process definitions
